offline_video_intervention.interpretation: Changing only the human video at a fixed saved development RGB/qpos observation measures input sensitivity and condition-cache restoration. A cross-task swap does not establish task-semantic necessity or effects on rollout success.

limitations: Two L0 source tasks with supervised Piper robot data; not the full TIG benchmark, held-out task transfer, or zero-shot embodiment transfer.
One training seed per condition and ten fixed evaluation seeds per task; the 60% versus 50% macro success rates are descriptive observations, not an established general video benefit.
The fixed 6000-update budget is an engineering pilot budget; convergence, optimal stopping and the cause of lower pill performance have not been established.
The two task scenes differ, so success and the offline video-sensitivity check do not by themselves show that video semantics are necessary.
Failure stages summarize sampled task predicates; they do not by themselves establish a unique physical cause.
Large checkpoints, videos, trajectories and raw world arrays are retained under the evidence root and are not embedded in this record.

data_audit.conclusion: No task-routing, train-only normalizer or padding error found; both tasks have a static prefix, which alone cannot establish the cause of failure.

offline_inference.method: Actual get_action with zero CVAE latent on real expert development public RGB/qpos; expert future actions are comparison targets only. Not posterior-conditioned training loss.
offline_inference.clip_intervention_scope: H31 episodes0-5 at the same development seed7000 initial observation; episode5 is already consumed test material and is not used for checkpoint selection.
offline_inference.interpretation: Later initial chunk queries predict more starting motion; similar first-frame outputs across six clips do not support an ep4-only explanation. Offline error does not establish rollout success.

paired_pill_failure_diagnosis.comparison_scope: Four failure/success pairs share initial scene state, but their separately trained policies and later observations differ. These trajectories do not isolate a causal effect of video content alone.
paired_pill_failure_diagnosis.time_contract: Post-state/event s follows action[s-1]; offline t112/128/160/184 are saved pre-action observation/replanning indices.

video_failures.interpretation: Approach disturbed the left object and transient contact did not develop into stable lifted possession; right object placed. Contact geometry/forces not uniquely identified.

constant_failures.fact: Both grasp from81 to200; after lifting, commanded and actual arms remain near pickup. Post-action mean arm error during action[128,200) about0.0023rad; final objects outside regions.

Both grasp from81 to200; commands and actual arms dwell after lifting, then progress late. During action[112,184) mean arm error about0.0019rad; final16 actions move TCPs about0.215/0.205m, but objects remain held outside regions.

paired_pill_failure_diagnosis.offline_interpretation: Selected holding observations have substantially larger coordinated joint-target changes in unexecuted queries8..15 than in queries0..7. Supports an execution-window/phase-progression interaction as a candidate explanation, not proof that execute16 will move toward the target or succeed. Video success cases can also have larger later-half motion.

controller_contract.grasp_predicate: Instantaneous double-finger contact force/direction, not sustained load-bearing possession. Positive gripper command may still be partially closed.
controller_contract.official_success: Original region membership remains authoritative; constant24014 succeeds while still grasping left object. No added release requirement.
controller_contract.physical_uncertainty: Contact force vectors, drive targets/torques and physics-substep contact details are absent; cannot uniquely assign geometry, friction or force saturation.

paired_pill_failure_diagnosis.diagnostic_preprocessing_correction: Retained first1-call failure. Offline script initially divided RGB by255 on CPU; recorded CUDA-renderer RGB divides on GPU. decision.then: Investigate grasp approach robustness and goal following through separate controlled development studies; do not alter task physics or add evaluation gates to eliminate these failures.

execution_window_9k_development.descriptive_marker_contract: First sampled grasp anchors +8cm TCP lift and +5cm XY TCP displacement along the initial object-to-goal-center direction. These are timing descriptors, not success/quality/rejection requirements. A missing crossing is right-censored at state200; censored delays are lower-bound observations, not completed transport times.
execution_window_9k_development.interpretation: Execute16 improves constant pill7001 from timeout to success143, with earlier lift and subsequent transport. All prior11 successes remain successful; timing is not uniformly faster. Supports an execution-window contribution on these development cases, not universal optimality or a video benefit. Prior video approach failures were not rerun here and are not declared fixed.
